title: Spatially Gated Demographic Steering for Debiasing Multi-Person Text-to-Image Generation

problem.summary: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene.
statements: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene.
In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image.
Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline.

background.summary: Base is demographically homogeneous; EA shifts everyone uniformly; FairImagen is statistically indistinguishable from baseline on FLUX; SGS steers each instance toward a distinct intersectional target while preserving occupational context and scene coherence.

evidence.quote: Base is demographically homogeneous; EA shifts everyone uniformly; FairImagen is statistically indistinguishable from baseline on FLUX; SGS steers each instance toward a distinct intersectional target while preserving occupational context and scene coherence.
Global mitigation faces an inherent tension: improving aggregate balance requires collapsing intra-image diversity, sometimes below the unsteered baseline.

solution.summary: SGS performs per-instance demographic steering within the standard rectified flow denoising loop, requiring no model fine-tuning, no trajectory inversion, and no external spatial layout specification.
